title: Deliver Gold to Kintbridge Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Gold** delivered to **Kintbridge Bank** (industry id 9, near tile 17,80).

A likely supplier is **Beningville Gold Mine** (industry id 8, near tile 28,95); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **3,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
